FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
ProGolf & Sports Gear specializes in the retail of golf and sporting equipment, offering a wide selection of accessories to meet the needs of amateur and professional athletes alike. Our operations focus solely on providing high-quality sporting goods, with no involvement in equipment rental or repair services. This approach helps minimize liability risks associated with product misuse or damage. We prioritize maintaining a well-organized, clean, and safe shopping environment for our customers, supported by clear and documented safety protocols. Additionally, our store utilizes a professionally monitored alarm system to further enhance security. Our team is dedicated to delivering exceptional customer service and assisting each customer in finding the right equipment to enhance their sporting experience.

Our store offers a variety of sporting equipment for sale, and we also provide rental options for customers looking to try out golf clubs and other sports gear before making a purchase.
